statement: The names test, localhost, invalid and the example second-level domains are reserved as special-use; invalid names are guaranteed not to resolve in the normal way to any person or entity, and localhost resolves to the loopback host.
inference: A mailbox at one of these names cannot be delivered to a person. This establishes non-attributable, not that a self-declared or labelled use is non-sensitive.

notes: Only the sections named were read; the registry of special-use names has changed since 2013 and was not read.
